Kinetic installation · 2025

Echo Chamber of a Top Player (Retired)

A wall-mounted kinetic installation combining repeated sculptural elements, custom wood panels, and Arduino-controlled servo motors.

Medium
Servo motors, custom wood panels, painted MDF, Arduino microcontrollers, wiring, wall-mounted hardware
Dimensions
8 × 16 ft
Year
2025

Exhibited in Harmony Brings Prosperity, East Gallery, Claremont, CA.
